full_judgment: 2. The plaintiff  Mosammat Shefali Begum and three others instituted Other Class Suit No. 109 of 1982 seeking a declaration that the order dated 18.10.1982 passed by the Additional Commissioner, Rajshahi Division in Appeal Case No. 100 of 1978 is illegal, void and not binding upon them. They contended that Tarakanath Pramanik the original landlord of the suit land i. e 0.70 decimals of land gave pattan to Anil Ranjan in 1335 B. S, who in turn gave the said 0.70 decimals of land to Monindra Nath Pramanik by way of pattan and delivered possession. Monindra Nath Pramanik sold 0.70 decimals of land to the plaintiffs by kabala dated 17.1.1977.
